title: Basic elements of Helsinki’s visual identity
slide_intent: Read identity as a coordinated set of ingredients because recognition can depend on more than the logo.
strategic_value: Helsinki can connect its multilingual marks, type, colors and imagery through one visible inventory.
demonstration: This webpage artwork arranges logos, type specimens, color circles, photography, illustration, wave motifs, information graphics and icons in a three-column grid.
practical_value: Check which ingredient families a new communication needs.
